threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still wait for the bus without checking Citymapper first, as if that 243 might just magically appear. Bless your heart.
Last night on the 59, a guy serenaded the whole bus with old soul tracks. Everyone pretended to be asleep, but I saw at least three people tapping along.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I heard a kid argue passionately with their mom in Turkish about which döner shop is the best on my street.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a techno party that starts at 6 AM and ends at sunset, all while your neighbors cheer from their balconies.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can tell a local by how they instinctively check BART delays before deciding if it's worth getting a burrito at La Taqueria. The weight of the commute is real.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a glimpse of a mom juggling a stroller while reassuring her toddler on a packed 38. Just a Tuesday in the 'loin.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia's just about the plaça and bars, but many miss the quiet charm of its hidden gardens and the locals tending their community veggie patches.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They still stop to take photos of the street performers in Plaça del Sol, clueless that they've been there since before the pandemic.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think a bus is quicker than a bike here. That’s cute, hon, but the Hackney bike life has its own rhythm.
Caught the N35 last night, and a guy was playing the sax. Everyone clapped when he hit those high notes. Only in Brixton, right?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw the kebab shop owner arguing with the delivery guy about missing hot sauce, and both were laughing by the end. That's Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a café with a giant trampoline in the backyard, while the owner debates philosophy with patrons over organic coffee.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: A true local knows to avoid BART during rush hour after a breakdown—everyone else just stands there confused, wondering what the loud bang was.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy serenading the 38 bus with a ukulele while waiting for the 47. Only in SF does a bus stop become a stage.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: They think the park guell statues are the main attraction, but the real magic is the quiet streets of the neighborhood after sunset.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still hesitate at crosswalks, waiting for the 'green man' despite the cars having stopped.
